name: Robin Roost
tagline: Elder-care coordination for people who became the family project manager overnight.
positioning: Robin Roost keeps your parents' care in one place—meds, appointments, caregivers, and the siblings—so you stop running it all from a group text.

hero.h1: You didn't sign up to be your parents' operations manager.
hero.sub: Robin Roost puts every medication, appointment, caregiver shift, and 'is Mom okay?' text into one calm dashboard—so you can coordinate care without color-coded panic.

features.title: The Care Calendar
features.description: Doctor visits, caregiver shifts, and pill refills in one shared view. Dad's cardiologist appointment stops living rent-free in your head.

features.title: Medication Roll Call
features.description: Track every prescription, dose, and refill date. Get pinged before the pharmacy closes—not after Mom's quietly skipped two days.

features.title: The Sibling Feed
features.description: One update thread your brother can't claim he never saw. Notes, photos, and receipts, minus the 2 a.m. accusatory texts.

features.title: Document Drawer
features.description: Insurance cards, power of attorney, DNR, and Medicare letters—scanned, tagged, and findable at the ER instead of in a shoebox.

features.title: Caregiver Handoffs
features.description: Give paid aides and helpful neighbors exactly what they need, nothing they don't. Shift notes that actually get read.

features.title: The Whole Picture
features.description: Trends across appointments, meds, and mood, so you catch the slow slide before it becomes a 3 a.m. hospital call.

testimonials.quote: I was running my mother's care out of a Notes app and 200 unread texts. Now my brothers can see everything and pretend they were always this involved.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

testimonials.quote: I manage care for nine clients across three counties. Robin Roost is the first tool that didn't assume I work inside a 400-bed facility.
testimonials.name: Deborah Okafor

testimonials.quote: My siblings and I stopped fighting about who forgot the neurologist. Turns out we just needed one calendar and slightly fewer feelings.
testimonials.name: Tom Brennan

pricing.blurb: For the only child quietly doing absolutely all of it.
Split the chaos across siblings who mean well.
When you'd rather hand the whole binder to a grown-up.

homepage.footerBlurb: Robin Roost is care coordination for the sandwich generation. Not a hospital, not a hotline—just one place to run the hardest job you never applied for.
